method: Sixteen interleaved independent cases, four geometry families, two mesh or duration conditions. Full wall includes grouping, preparation, graph capture, stepping and output transfer. All native final fields, point traces, snapshots and three six-component nine-frequency DFT planes are retained. External flaport 0.2.2 uses unmodified E/H updates and the same fused DFT adapter with 1/8-step graphs. No padding or discretization changes between modes. One warmup per mode, three measured repetitions in alternating order by default. Cold interpreter/context/compiler, validation and disk I/O excluded. Torch memory excludes external graph, context and driver allocations. Native graph width 1.
